acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of kitchen cabinet upgrades in Berkeley varies widely based on factors such as cabinet material, custom features, labor, and the scope of the project. Basic refacing can start from a few thousand dollars, while a full replacement with custom cabinetry can range from $15,000 to $50,000 or more. We provide detailed estimates after an initial consultation.
